For the uninitiated: Art Bell returned to radio on 20 July 2015 with his much anticipated news internet streaming paranormal radio show Midnight In The Desert. The show was great and it's ratings were phenomenal with many conventional radio stations wanting to broadcast it too. In December 2015, Art announced a surprise retirement after claims that his family were repeatedly being harassed by one or more armed terrorists... and Heather Wade took over his show. Art's return to guest host a single show is exciting because it may be an indication that Art will guest host some more shows at some time or hopefully return in some capacity.

Review of the show

I was initially shocked because Art sounded terrible: he seemed distracted and lethargic with long, strained pauses in his speech. This really disturbed me because I thought Art's last few shows before he retirement were some of his best, most energetic and entertaining... and now his performance seemed lackluster and low-energy.

I've seen colleagues age rapidly after retirement and I wondered if Art had suffered a similar fate... or perhaps something was troubling him... perhaps he hadn't discussed his guest hosting with his wife? Fortunately Art warmed up and returned to his usual energetic and enthusiastic self within about fifteen minutes. That said, I suspect something was troubling Art during the start of the show... and I wonder if we'll ever know what the trouble was?

Art spent much of the first hour discussing news, politics and the latest scientific discoveries including the proof of Einstein gravitational wave theory.

Art invited people to discuss any topic during the night's open lines and also suggested people consider the topics of Donald Trump and what they would do if they had no fear...

Art spoke about his latest hobbies: binge watching House of Cards and flying a beastly drone over the valleys of Pahrump at altitudes of about 200 feet in an attempt to exceed the range of shot-guns. A few open line callers also discussed drone related questions with Art.

Art did not play Dancing Queen.

This show was great and Art fully regained his excited and energetic former glory after a brief and shaky start and he sounded like he had a ball doing the show and I suspected he missed discussing science and politics and news with his fans. Although Art mentioned nothing about the possibility of guest hosting more shows in the future, I hope and suspect we may hear from Art over the coming weeks about what his plans may be...
